sloka: आलिखन्तीमिवाकाशमुत्थिताम् पश्य लक्ष्मण ।मन्सेव कृताम् लङ्काम् नगाग्रे विश्वकर्मणा ॥६-२४-९॥।।
transliteration: ālikhantīmivākāśamutthitām paśya lakṣmaṇa ।manseva kṛtām laṅkām nagāgre viśvakarmaṇā ॥6-24-9॥।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana, you may see the city of Lanka elevated on top of the mountain as though clasping the sky, like the one created in the mind of Vishwakarma."
